title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Sales Development agent for autonomous lead outreach
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents a beta API for activating agent templates and assigning the users or groups allowed to create instances, so the activation row incorrectly says automation is not documented. The roadmap details, preview opt-in and Copilot Credit charges are supported; several navigation paths need minor completion.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes an autonomous agent that researches, qualifies and engages leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.
claims.quote: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.

claims.claim: The documented preview is admin-opt-in: an administrator must activate the agent before users can create instances.

claims.claim: Activation and creator access are reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All Agents > Sales Development (Frontier) > Activate.
claims.quote: Search for Sales Development (Frontier), and then select Activate. ... Choose the users or groups that can create Sales Development agent instances.
claims.fix: Keep the documented entry path, but make the note explicit: 'After Activate, choose the users or groups that can create instances, then apply a policy template that allows agent instance creation.' The path ends at the entrance to that configuration.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for activating the template and choosing who can create instances.
claims.quote: Activate an already-onboarded agent template for the users or groups allowed to create instances from it, and apply the selected policy template.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api null with kind graph, call 'POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/activate', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackageactivationresult-activate. Add to the note: 'Reviewed beta contract; availability depends on the matching schema and backend release. agentManagerScope selects allowed creators; policyTemplateId selects an existing policy template. Requires Agent 365 and a signed-in AI Administrator or Global Administrator; does not grant permission consent.' Cite that reference.

claims.claim: The activation page gives Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > Copilot Frontier, while the Frontier guide includes View all.
claims.quote: Copilot Frontier is enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot > Settings > Copilot Frontier.
claims.fix: Use 'Copilot > Settings > View all > Copilot Frontier > Turn on Frontier' for controls[1].ui.path and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/get-started-frontier for its docs, retaining the note that the activation page gives the shorter path. The cited Frontier guide documents the selectable View all tab and the final toggle.
